raw.query: WITH reactive AS (SELECT window_name, COUNT(*) AS n_runs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation) AS n_violations FROM provenance.v_infraction WHERE is_current AND policy = 'reactive' AND window_name LIKE 'burst%' GROUP BY window_name) SELECT SUM(n_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(n_violations) AS total_violations, ROUND(100.0*SUM(n_violations)/SUM(n_runs),1) AS pct FROM reactive;
raw.observed: reactive burst-window runs: 130 total, 90 violations = 69.2% (per-window range 53.3%-100%)
raw.evidence: v_infraction shows ~69% of reactive burst-window runs violate SLA (90/130), not the claimed ~33% — reality is roughly 2x worse than stated, so the 'a third' figure is overclaimed
